'''Modesto Montoya''' (born 24 February 1949) is a [[nuclear physicist]] and former president of the [[Peruvian Institute of Nuclear Energy]] in Lima, [[Peru]].  He is a former president and current member of the Peruvian Academy of Nuclear Sciences, former president of the Peruvian Physical Society and member for Peruvian National Academy of Sciences. In 2021, he became an advisor to President [[Pedro Castillo]] on science matters.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Peru's new president is controversial. Here's why scientists have high hopes for him|url=https://www.science.org/content/article/peru-s-new-president-controversial-here-s-why-scientists-have-high-hopes-him|access-date=2021-11-24|website=www.science.org|language=en}}</ref> He served as [[Ministry of Environment (Peru)|minister of the environment]] of [[Peru]].

==Academic activities==
Modesto Montoya was born in [[Salpo District|Salpo, La Libertad]]. At age 12, he began studies to be an electrical technician at the current National Polytechnic of [[Santa Province|Santa]]. At age 17, he received a scholarship to study at the José Pardo Principal Polytechnic. At the age of 18, he entered the [[National University of Engineering]].

He holds a BSc, a Lic. a MSc in physics from the [[National University of Engineering]], a [[Diplôme d'études approfondies|DEA]], a [[Doctorat#France|doctorat]] de 3eme cycle and a [[Doctorat#France|doctorat]] d'Etat from the [[Paris-Sud 11 University]]. He is affiliated as professor to the National University of Engineering and he teaches scientific and technological subjects at [[Centro de Preparación para la Ciencia y Tecnología]] (Ceprecyt).<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.ceprecyt.org/|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20031119005130/http://www.ceprecyt.org/|url-status=dead|archive-date=19 November 2003|title=Centro de Preparación para la Ciencia y Tecnología – CEPRECYT (San Antonio, Miraflores, Lima, LM, Perú)}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.uni.edu.pe/|title=Universidad Nacional de Ingeniería - UNI|website=www.uni.edu.pe}}</ref>

==Research==
Montoya's research work was on [[cold fission]] at the [[CEA Saclay]] and he participated in the discovery of nucleon-pair breaking in cold fission,<ref>{{cite journal|doi=10.1051/jphyslet:019810042019043700|title=Evidence for nucleon pair breaking even in the coldest scission configurations of 234U and 236U |year=1981 |last1=Signarbieux |first1=C. |last2=Montoya |first2=M. |last3=Ribrag |first3=M. |last4=Mazur |first4=C. |last5=Guet |first5=C. |last6=Perrin |first6=P. |last7=Maurel |first7=M. |journal=Journal de Physique Lettres |volume=42 |issue=19 |pages=437–440 |url=https://hal.archives-ouvertes.fr/jpa-00231968/file/ajp-jphyslet_1981_42_19_437_0.pdf }}</ref><ref>{{cite journal |doi=10.1051/jphys:01983004407078500|title=Nucleon pair breaking in the thermal neutron induced fission of 233U and 235U |year=1983 |last1=Montoya |first1=M. |journal=Journal de Physique |volume=44 |issue=7 |pages=785–790 |s2cid=593653 |url=https://hal.science/jpa-00209659 }}</ref> phenomenum studied also by Hervé Nifenecker<ref>{{cite book|doi=10.1007/BFb0021503|chapter=A combinatorial analysis of pair-breaking in fission |title=Dynamics of Nuclear Fission and Related Collective Phenomena |series=Lecture Notes in Physics |year=1982 |last1=Nifenecker |first1=H. |last2=Mariolopoulos |first2=G. |last3=Bocquet |first3=J. P. |last4=Brissot |first4=R. |last5=Hamelin |first5=Mme Ch. |last6=Crançon |first6=J. |last7=Ristori |first7=Ch. |volume=158 |pages=47–66 |isbn=978-3-540-11548-9 |s2cid=121139253 }}</ref> in cold fission of [[uranium]] 233, [[uranium 235]] and [[plutonium]] 239.  He also studied the mass and kinetic energy distribution of fragments in cold fission.<ref>{{cite journal|doi=10.1007/BF01415636|title=Mass and kinetic energy distribution in cold fission of233U,235U and239Pu induced by thermal neutrons |year=1984 |last1=Montoya |first1=M. |journal=Zeitschrift für Physik A |volume=319 |issue=2 |pages=219–225 |bibcode=1984ZPhyA.319..219M |s2cid=121150912 }}</ref>

Between 1985 and 1986 he was guest scientist at ([[Gesellschaft für Schwerionenforschung|GSI]]) in [[Darmstadt]] in the group led by [[Peter Armbruster]], dedicated to research on transuranides nuclei.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.gsi.de/forschung/kp/kp2/ship/heavyel_e.html |title=Heavy Elements |accessdate=2009-02-22 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20070820095029/http://www.gsi.de/forschung/kp/kp2/ship/heavyel_e.html |archivedate=20 August 2007 |df=dmy-all }} Münzenberg, ''G. et al.''. "Attempt to synthesize element 110 by fusion of 64Ni + 208Pb", GSI Annual Report GSI-86-1/ 1985, p. 29.</ref><ref>{{cite journal |url=http://adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/1986NuPhA.447..335H | doi=10.1016/0375-9474(86)90615-9| bibcode=1986NuPhA.447..335H| title=The influence of the surprising decay properties of element 108 on search experiments for new elements| last1=Hofmann| first1=S.| last2=Armbruster| first2=P.| last3=Münzenberg| first3=G.| last4=Reisdorf| first4=W.| last5=Schmidt| first5=K. -H.| last6=Burkhard| first6=H. G.| last7=Hessberger| first7=F. P.| last8=Schött| first8=H. -J.| last9=Agarwal| first9=Y. K.| last10=Berthes| first10=G.| last11=Gollerthan| first11=U.| last12=Folger| first12=H.| last13=Hingmann| first13=R.| last14=Keller| first14=J. G.| last15=Leino| first15=M. E.| last16=Lemmertz| first16=P.| last17=Montoya| first17=M.| last18=Poppensieker| first18=K.| last19=Quint| first19=B.| last20=Zychor| first20=I.| journal=Nuclear Physics A| year=1986| volume=447| page=335}}</ref> At GSI published his work on Coulomb and shell effects in low energy fission.,<ref>Modesto Montoya, "Shell and coulomb effects in thermal neutron induced cold fission of U-233, U-235, and Pu-239", Radiation Effects and Defects in Solids, Volume 93, Issue 1–4 March 1986, pages 9 – 12</ref><ref>{{cite journal|doi=10.1007/BF01294620|title=Coulomb effects in low energy fission |year=1986 |last1=Montoya |first1=M. |last2=Hasse |first2=R. W. |last3=Koczon |first3=P. |journal=Zeitschrift für Physik A |volume=325 |issue=3 |pages=357–362 |bibcode=1986ZPhyA.325..357M |s2cid=119745507 }}</ref>

As guest scientist at the Institut de Physique Nucléaire, [[Orsay]], in the Bernard Borderie's group, he participated in research on deeply inelastic collisions.<ref>{{Deprecated archive|url=https://archive.today/20120708044316/http://democrite.in2p3.fr/democrite-00016478/en/}} B. Borderie ''et al.''. "Deeply inelastic collisions as a source of intermediate mass fragments at E/A=27 MeV", ''Physics Letters'' B, Vol. 205 (1988), pp. 26–29</ref> He was also invited by the Carnegie-Mellon Institute in the Morton Kaplan group dedicated to ternary fragmentations in nuclear collisions.<ref>{{cite journal|doi=10.1016/S0370-2693(00)00407-X|title=Search for ternary fragmentation in the reaction 856 MeV 98Mo+51V: Kinematic probing of intermediate-mass-fragment emissions |year=2000 |last1=Vardaci |first1=Emanuele |last2=Kaplan |first2=Morton |last3=Parker |first3=Winifred E. |last4=Moses |first4=David J. |last5=Boger |first5=J.T. |last6=Gilfoyle |first6=G.J. |last7=McMahan |first7=M.A.|author7-link=Peggy Norris |last8=Montoya |first8=M. |journal=Physics Letters B |volume=480 |issue=3–4 |pages=239–244 |bibcode=2000PhLB..480..239V }}</ref>

Montoya now studies the effects of neutron emissions on measurements of fission fragments.<ref>{{cite book|doi=10.1063/1.2813826|chapter=Effects of Neutron Emission on Fragment Mass and Kinetic Energy Distribution from Thermal Neutron-Induced Fission of &#91;sup 235&#93;U |title=AIP Conference Proceedings |year=2007 |last1=Montoya |first1=M. |last2=Rojas |first2=J. |last3=Saetone |first3=E. |last4=Alarcon |first4=Ricardo |last5=Cole |first5=Philip L. |last6=Djalali |first6=Chaden |last7=Umeres |first7=Fernando |volume=947 |pages=326–329 |arxiv=0711.0954 |s2cid=9831107 }}</ref><ref>M. Montoya, E. Saettone, J. Rojas, "Monte Carlo Simulation for fragment mass and kinetic energy distribution from neutron-induced fission of U 235", Revista Mexicana de Física 53 (5) 366–370, oct 2007</ref><ref>M. Montoya, J. Rojas, I. Lobato, "Neutron emission effects on final fragments mass and kinetic energy distribution from low energy fission of U 234", Revista Mexicana de Física, 54(6) dic 2008</ref>

==Promoting science and technology==
Montoya has had his opinions on science and technology published in a number of articles in the main Peruvian newspapers. As part of his promotional activities he found the International Scientific Meeting (ECI) Encuentro Científico Internacional for which is recognized by international institutions.{{citation needed|date=March 2022}}
